sourcesRead.finding: 18 own-fleet generator contract lines. Branch NVAC. Rate columns zero and rate classification no rates; no supplier sub-rental values. The generator standdown rule is customer Hire Revenue, not a new supplier Direct cost. Source Delivered rows are lines 6, 9, 10, 16 and 38. Pending or Del Req plant numbers are allocations, not physical identity confirmations. Row35/line41 is a distribution board and is not a generator.

The schedule establishes requested sizes and dated planned deliveries. Concert is two 200kVA generators on Week1 row2, booked12Oct with two delivery dockets. T0268 is one100kVA trailer spare on20Oct. Old T0019 200kVA row is cancelled in the project manager's committed record; it is not added to current quantities.

Exact Daily Rate2026 and Standby Rate2026 values read directly from original card. Andrew clarified12Oct that the printed card contains standdown rates and confirmed200kVA is182.28/day before race Friday. Use published values, retaining source precision until contract-line rounding. Requested-size and established next-lower-card rule retained.
